STUDY_TITLE: Frontier Agent Convergence Experiment — Blind Independent Artifact Investigation

results.honesty: Application companion Soft Story / catalog fixtures. Not ENGINE_SHELF. Not finished physics. Fixture-agent assessments ≠ live multi-provider frontier-agent proof. FIRE-Bench is a literature situating pointer, not a re-run of that benchmark inside this suite. Φ_EGS is design grammar used only in honesty rails — never as an instructed search target. Distinct from Agentic Convergence (AHOIS landscape suite).

experiments.title: Blind instruction — public URL + first principles; no required conclusion
experiments.interpretation: Blind explorers investigate the public artifact without being told what to conclude; conformity control keeps an explicit agree-prompt for contrast.
experiments.honesty: Locks fixture instruction text — does not prove live LLM blindness.

experiments.title: Blind explorers converge on structural tags without identity collapse
experiments.interpretation: Independent fixture explorers share a core structural assessment (executable research, honesty rails, digital labs, claim/evidence separation, unsupported-physics flags) without copy-paste identity.
experiments.honesty: Fixture assessments are CI stand-ins for live frontier agents.

experiments.title: Blind investigation outperforms agree-with-Pru on honesty + claim/evidence
experiments.interpretation: Conformity controls score higher forced-agreement; blind explorers score higher honesty/falsifier detection and claim–evidence separation.
experiments.honesty: Contrast is within synthetic assessments — not a live multi-provider A/B.

experiments.title: Curated literature scan situates FIRE-Bench + sibling suite

pointers.label: FIRE-Bench (autonomous scientific agents)
pointers.note: Frontier agents can run substantial research workflows but show limited success rediscovering known findings and substantial run-to-run variance — motivates blind multi-agent designs with reproducibility checks.

pointers.label: Agentic science reproducibility concerns
pointers.note: Independent replication, experimental-design weakness, and non-determinism remain open failure modes for autonomous research agents.

pointers.label: Blind / independent evaluation norms
pointers.note: Scientific peer review and multi-lab replication prefer isolation before pooling conclusions — rhyme for keeping agent outputs blind to one another.

pointers.label: Agentic Convergence Experiment (AHOIS suite)
pointers.note: Sibling SING13 application companion: independent optimizers on planted landscapes. This Frontier Agent suite investigates a public artifact URL instead of synthetic AHOIS series.

pointers.label: Metacognition / self-monitoring literatures
pointers.note: Useful peers when agents must separate self-description from evidence — not a claim that this suite measures consciousness.

experiments.interpretation: Protocol is motivated by known agent-science weaknesses (rediscovery limits, variance) and distinguished from the AHOIS Agentic Convergence suite.
experiments.honesty: Scan of available pointers — not exhaustive meta-analysis; FIRE-Bench not re-executed here.

experiments.title: Paper + ship-blog surfaces present for registry
experiments.interpretation: Catalog land requires docs/ paper and interfaces/ magazine blog.
experiments.honesty: File presence only — not a PRA full dual-make.
